title: Oslo — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Oslo: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Oslo has a population of 693,000. Norway’s capital and economic center, surrounded by fjords and forests, known for its Viking history and modern architecture. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Sunshine is limited, with about 67 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
